title: AI System Design — Remove Single Points of Failure
key_insight: Identify failure domains and decide which need redundancy, graceful degradation, or an explicit stop. Circuit breakers prevent a failing dependency from consuming all capacity.
body:
## Remove Single Points of Failure

Every request depends on one provider and one retrieval index. Either outage stops the product.

Identify failure domains and decide which need redundancy, graceful degradation, or an explicit stop. Circuit breakers prevent a failing dependency from consuming all capacity.

Test partial failures, not only total outages. A stale cache, slow index, or malformed model response often causes subtler damage than a clean error.
common_mistakes: Choosing the largest model completes the entire system design.
A successful demo proves every dependency is reliable.
Production results need no record of their configuration version.
mini_exercise: Draw “Remove Single Points of Failure” as three labeled steps, then explain the decision at each step.
real_world_usage: Senior AI work requires reasoning about the whole product route rather than optimizing one model in isolation.
explain_back_prompt: Using “Remove Single Points of Failure,” explain AI System Design without assuming the listener knows AI engineering.
